       DATE(o.delivery_date) AS delivery_day,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_yen
FROM Order_Deliveries o
JOIN Delivery_Route_Locations l ON o.location_code = l.location_code
JOIN Addresses a ON l.location_address_id = a.address_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON o.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY a.state_province_county, DATE(o.delivery_date)
ORDER BY a.state_province_county, DATE(o.delivery_date);

votes.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM Customers c JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id AND ao.order_status_code = 'Success' JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) >= 5 AND SUM(p.product_price) >= 10000;

SELECT c.customer_name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) >= 5
    AND SUM(p.product_price) >= 10000;

WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT ao.actual_order_id, ao.regular_order_id
    FROM "Actual_Orders" ao
    WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
),
order_products AS (
    SELECT cop.actual_order_id, p.product_price
    FROM "Actual_Order_Products" cop
    JOIN "Products" p ON cop.product_id = p.product_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT co.actual_order_id) AS purchase_frequency,
           SUM(op.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN completed_orders co ON ro.regular_order_id = co.regular_order_id
    JOIN order_products op ON co.actual_order_id = op.actual_order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT customer_name
FROM customer_stats
WHERE purchase_frequency > 0 AND total_spent > 0;

votes.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING SUM(p.product_price) >= 10000
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) >= 5
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN ao.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) >= 0.9;

SELECT c.customer_id
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(p.product_price) >= 10000 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) >= 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN ao.order_status_code = 'Success' OR ao.order_status_code = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3;

WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price), 0) AS total_spent,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) AS order_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ao.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    LEFT JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
    LEFT JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT customer_name
FROM customer_metrics
WHERE total_spent >= 5000
  AND order_count >= 5
  AND CASE WHEN order_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE success_count * 1.0 / order_count END >= 0.8;
}

WITH route_stats AS (
    SELECT dr.route_id,
           dr.route_name,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN ABS((strftime('%s', od.delivery_date) - strftime('%s', ao.actual_order_date)) / 60.0) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS percent_on_time
    FROM Delivery_Routes dr
    JOIN Delivery_Route_Locations drl ON dr.route_id = drl.route_id
    JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON drl.location_code = od.location_code
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    GROUP BY dr.route_id, dr.route_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT route_name,
           percent_on_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY percent_on_time DESC) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_routes
    FROM route_stats
)
SELECT route_name,
       percent_on_time
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= (total_routes + 9) / 10
ORDER BY percent_on_time DESC;

WITH RouteDeliveryStats AS (
    SELECT 
        dr.route_id,
        dr.route_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_deliveries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ABS((julianday(od.delivery_date) - julianday(ao.actual_order_date)) * 24 * 60) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time_deliveries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ABS((julianday(od.delivery_date) - julianday(ao.actual_order_date)) * 24 * 60) <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as on_time_percentage
    FROM Delivery_Routes dr
    JOIN Delivery_Route_Locations drl ON dr.route_id = drl.route_id
    JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON drl.location_code = od.location_code
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    GROUP BY dr.route_id, dr.route_name
),
RankedRoutes AS (
    SELECT 
        route_id,
        route_name,
        on_time_percentage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY on_time_percentage DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_routes
    FROM RouteDeliveryStats
)
SELECT 
    route_name,
    on_time_percentage
FROM RankedRoutes
WHERE rn <= CAST(CEIL(total_routes * 0.1) AS INTEGER)
ORDER BY on_time_percentage DESC;

WITH route_stats AS (
    SELECT
        dr.route_id,
        dr.route_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(strftime('%s', od.delivery_date) - strftime('%s', ao.actual_order_date)) <= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_deliveries,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(strftime('%s', od.delivery_date) - strftime('%s', ao.actual_order_date)) <= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
    FROM Order_Deliveries od
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Delivery_Route_Locations drl ON od.location_code = drl.location_code
    JOIN Delivery_Routes dr ON drl.route_id = dr.route_id
    GROUP BY dr.route_id, dr.route_name
)
SELECT route_name
FROM (
    SELECT route_name, percentage,
           NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY percentage DESC) AS decile
    FROM route_stats
)
WHERE decile = 1
ORDER BY percentage DESC;

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_value,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) AS order_cnt,
           SUM(p.product_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT ao.actual_order_id) AS avg_order_value
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
    WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
avg_total AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_value) AS avg_total FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT cs.customer_name,
       cs.avg_order_value,
       (
           SELECT p3.product_name
           FROM "Products" p3
           JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop3 ON aop3.product_id = p3.product_id
           JOIN "Actual_Orders" ao3 ON ao3.actual_order_id = aop3.actual_order_id
           JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro3 ON ro3.regular_order_id = ao3.regular_order_id
           WHERE ro3.distributer_id = cs.customer_id
             AND ao3.order_status_code = 'Success'
           GROUP BY p3.product_id
           ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p3.product_name
           LIMIT 1
       ) AS most_ordered_product
FROM customer_stats cs, avg_total at
WHERE cs.total_value >= at.avg_total
ORDER BY cs.total_value DESC;

        ROUND(AVG(p.product_price), 2) AS avg_order_value
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN Actual_Orders a ON ro.regular_order_id = a.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON a.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE a.order_status_code = 'Success'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.actual_order_id) >= 5
),
TopProductPerCustomer AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        aop.product_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN Actual_Orders a ON ro.regular_order_id = a.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON a.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    WHERE a.order_status_code = 'Success'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, aop.product_id
    HAVING c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM PlatinumCustomers)
)
SELECT 
    pc.customer_name,
    pc.avg_order_value,
    tpc.product_id
FROM PlatinumCustomers pc
JOIN TopProductPerCustomer tpc ON pc.customer_id = tpc.customer_id
WHERE tpc.rn = 1
ORDER BY pc.completed_orders DESC, pc.avg_order_value DESC;

WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT
        ao.actual_order_id,
        ro.distributer_id AS customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS order_total
    FROM "Actual_Orders" ao
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
    GROUP BY ao.actual_order_id, ro.distributer_id
),
customer_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(order_total) AS total_spent,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value
    FROM completed_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT
        co.customer_id,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        COUNT(*) AS product_cnt
    FROM completed_orders co
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON co.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, p.product_id, p.product_name
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        pc.customer_id,
        pc.product_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.customer_id ORDER BY pc.product_cnt DESC, pc.product_name ASC) AS rn
    FROM product_counts pc
)
SELECT
    c.customer_name,
    ca.avg_order_value,
    rp.product_name AS most_ordered_product
FROM customer_aggregates ca
JOIN "Customers" c ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN ranked_products rp ON ca.customer_id = rp.customer_id AND rp.rn = 1
WHERE ca.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM customer_aggregates);

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ao.actual_order_id,
        ro.distributer_id AS customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_usd,
        ao.actual_order_date,
        od.delivery_date
    FROM Actual_Orders ao
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON od.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
    WHERE od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered'
      AND (julianday(od.delivery_date) - julianday(ao.actual_order_date)) <= 3
    GROUP BY ao.actual_order_id
)
SELECT
    c.customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ot.total_usd) * 0.85, 2) AS total_eur
FROM order_totals ot
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ot.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;

This may inaccurately calculate the delivery window duration (e.g., an order placed at 23:00 Day 1 delivered at 01:00 Day 5 would count as within 3 calendar days if cast to DATE, but is actually > 3 days duration).

    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON q.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY q.customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_name, (os.spend_usd * 0.85) AS total_eur
FROM order_spend os
JOIN "Customers" c ON os.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH latest_address AS (
    SELECT ca.customer_id,
           a.state_province_county AS state,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.customer_id ORDER BY ca.date_from DESC) AS rn
    FROM Customer_Addresses ca
    JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = ca.address_id
    WHERE ca.date_to IS NULL
),
customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT cs.customer_name,
       la.state AS primary_state,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS rank
FROM customer_spend cs
JOIN latest_address la ON la.customer_id = cs.customer_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND cs.total_spent >= 10000
ORDER BY rank;

WITH Customer_Spend AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spend
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
Customer_Primary_Address AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.customer_id,
        a.state_province_county
    FROM Customer_Addresses ca
    JOIN Addresses a ON ca.address_id = a.address_id
    WHERE ca.date_to IS NULL
       OR ca.date_from = (
           SELECT MAX(ca2.date_from)
           FROM Customer_Addresses ca2
           WHERE ca2.customer_id = ca.customer_id
       )
),
Ranked_Customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_name,
        cpas.state_province_county AS delivery_state,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spend DESC) AS spend_rank
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Spend cs ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Customer_Primary_Address cpas ON c.customer_id = cpas.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_name,
    delivery_state,
    spend_rank
FROM Ranked_Customers
WHERE spend_rank = 1;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
    WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
primary_address AS (
    SELECT ca.customer_id,
           a.state_province_county AS primary_state
    FROM "Customer_Addresses" ca
    JOIN "Addresses" a ON a.address_id = ca.address_id
    WHERE ca.address_type = 'House'
      AND ca.date_from = (
          SELECT MAX(ca2.date_from)
          FROM "Customer_Addresses" ca2
          WHERE ca2.customer_id = ca.customer_id
            AND ca2.address_type = 'House'
      )
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT cs.customer_id,
           c.customer_name,
           pa.primary_state,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS dr
    FROM customer_spend cs
    JOIN "Customers" c ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN primary_address pa ON pa.customer_id = cs.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_name,
       primary_state,
       dr
FROM ranked
WHERE dr = 1;

SELECT addr.state_province_county AS state,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue_eur
FROM Actual_Order_Products aop
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Customers c ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Customer_Addresses ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN Addresses addr ON ca.address_id = addr.address_id
WHERE ca.date_from <= ao.actual_order_date
  AND (ca.date_to IS NULL OR ca.date_to >= ao.actual_order_date)
GROUP BY addr.state_province_county
ORDER BY total_revenue_eur DESC;

SELECT c.customer_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN p.product_price ELSE 0 END) * 0.85, 2) AS total_spend_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.actual_order_id), 2) AS success_percentage
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders a ON a.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = a.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
WHERE a.actual_order_date >= date('now', '-1 year')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN p.product_price ELSE 0 END) > 20000
   AND (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_status_code = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.actual_order_id)) >= 95;

    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE ao.actual_order_date >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
),
Delivery_Success AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.actual_order_id,
        cs.customer_id,
        CASE WHEN od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_delivered,
        1 AS total_count
    FROM Actual_Orders ao
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN Customers cs ON ro.distributer_id = cs.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON ao.actual_order_id = od.actual_order_id
    WHERE ao.actual_order_date >= datetime('now', '-1 year')
)
SELECT 
    cs.customer_name,
    ROUND(cs.total_spent * 0.85, 2) AS total_spend_euros,
    ROUND((SUM(ds.is_delivered) * 100.0) / SUM(ds.total_count), 2) AS success_percentage
FROM Customer_Spending cs
JOIN Delivery_Success ds ON cs.customer_id = ds.customer_id
GROUP BY cs.customer_id, cs.customer_name
HAVING cs.total_spent > 20000
    AND (SUM(ds.is_delivered) * 100.0 / SUM(ds.total_count)) >= 95

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(actual_order_date) AS max_od FROM "Actual_Orders"),
spend_cte AS (
    SELECT c."customer_id", c."customer_name", SUM(p."product_price") AS total_spend_usd
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" r ON r."distributer_id" = c."customer_id"
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" o ON o."regular_order_id" = r."regular_order_id"
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON aop."actual_order_id" = o."actual_order_id"
    JOIN "Products" p ON p."product_id" = aop."product_id"
    WHERE o."actual_order_date" >= (SELECT date(max_od, '-1 year') FROM max_date)
    GROUP BY c."customer_id", c."customer_name"
),
delivery_cte AS (
    SELECT c."customer_id",
           COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
           SUM(CASE WHEN od."delivery_status_code" = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_deliveries
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Regular_Orders" r ON r."distributer_id" = c."customer_id"
    JOIN "Actual_Orders" o ON o."regular_order_id" = r."regular_order_id"
    JOIN "Order_Deliveries" od ON od."actual_order_id" = o."actual_order_id"
    WHERE o."actual_order_date" >= (SELECT date(max_od, '-1 year') FROM max_date)
    GROUP BY c."customer_id"
)
SELECT s."customer_name",
       (s.total_spend_usd * 0.9) AS total_spend_eur,
       (d.successful_deliveries * 100.0 / d.total_deliveries) AS success_percentage
FROM spend_cte s
JOIN delivery_cte d ON s."customer_id" = d."customer_id"
WHERE s.total_spend_usd > 20000
  AND (d.successful_deliveries * 100.0 / d.total_deliveries) >= 95;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT ro.distributer_id AS customer_id,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spend
    FROM Actual_Orders ao
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY ro.distributer_id
)
SELECT customer_id,
       total_spend,
       NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS spend_group
FROM customer_spend
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;

WITH CustomerSpend AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spend
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
    JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
    JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE ao.order_status_code NOT IN ('Cancel')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
)
SELECT 
    customer_name,
    total_spend,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS spending_quintile
FROM CustomerSpend
ORDER BY spending_quintile ASC, total_spend DESC;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.customer_name,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spend
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id

    GROUP BY c.customer_name
),
adjusted AS (
    SELECT customer_name,
           total_spend AS adjusted_total_spend
    FROM customer_spend

SELECT customer_name,
       adjusted_total_spend,
       NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_total_spend DESC) AS quintile

votes.sql:
SELECT SUM(p.product_price) * (
           SELECT AVG(r.rate)
           FROM Exchange_Rates r
           WHERE r.year = 2018 AND r.month = 3
       ) AS total_sales_eur
FROM Order_Deliveries od
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON od.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered'
  AND od.delivery_date >= '2018-03-01' AND od.delivery_date < '2018-04-01';

SELECT SUM(p.product_price * 0.82) AS total_sales_euros
FROM Actual_Orders ao
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON ao.actual_order_id = aop.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON aop.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', ao.actual_order_date) = '2018-03'

WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT p."product_price"
    FROM "Actual_Orders" ao
    JOIN "Actual_Order_Products" aop ON ao."actual_order_id" = aop."actual_order_id"
    JOIN "Products" p ON aop."product_id" = p."product_id"
    WHERE ao."order_status_code" = 'Delivered'
      AND strftime('%Y-%m', ao."actual_order_date") = '2018-03'
)
SELECT SUM(d."product_price") * (
    SELECT AVG(er."exchange_rate")
    FROM "ExchangeRates" er
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', er."rate_date") = '2018-03'
) AS total_sales_eur
FROM delivered;

votes.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON ro.distributer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ao.regular_order_id = ro.regular_order_id
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
JOIN Customer_Addresses ca ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id
    AND ca.date_from <= ao.actual_order_date
    AND (ca.date_to IS NULL OR ao.actual_order_date < ca.date_to)
JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = ca.address_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY SUM(p.product_price) DESC
LIMIT 5;

votes.sql:
SELECT p.product_name,
       SUM(p.product_price * er.rate) AS total_sales_eur
FROM Products p
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
JOIN (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rate_date) AS year_month,
           AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM Exchange_Rates
    GROUP BY year_month
) er ON er.year_month = strftime('%Y-%m', ao.actual_order_date)
GROUP BY p.product_name;

SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(p.product_price) * 0.85, 2) AS total_sales_euros FROM Products p JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON p.product_id = aop.product_id JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;

SELECT p.product_name,
       SUM(p.product_price * er.rate) AS total_sales_euros
FROM Products p
JOIN Actual_Order_Products aop ON p.product_id = aop.product_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
JOIN ExchangeRates er ON er.year = strftime('%Y', ao.actual_order_date)
                     AND er.month = strftime('%m', ao.actual_order_date)
GROUP BY p.product_name;
